title: Predict Stock Prices with ARIMA and LSTM
label_definition: next-day unscaled high price from a 60-day history window
training_protocol: ARIMA trains on 2016-2017 with order (1,0,1); LSTM trains on 2010-2015, validates on 2016-2017, uses 60-day windows, three 100-unit LSTM layers, dropout 0.1 and Adam
evaluation_protocol: fixed out-of-sample calendar split; both models test on 2018
preprocessing_protocol: 60-day supervised sequences; exact scaler behavior not independently verified
unknowns: complete list of all 50 tickers is not structured in the paper text

evidence_spans.quote: The dataset consists of the highest price on transaction days.
Fifty listed-company stocks from Yahoo Finance are selected.
Observations are stock highs on transaction days.
Sixty days of data are used to predict the next day.
The models predict the next transaction day's high price.
The sample spans 1 January 2010 through 31 December 2018.
Each prediction uses a sixty-day historical price sequence.
The study compares ARIMA and LSTM stock-price forecasts.
LSTM trains on 2010-2015 and validates on 2016-2017.
The LSTM experiment converts sixty-day histories into supervised sequences.
evidence_spans.summary: Defines sequence preprocessing; scaling details require code confirmation.

evidence_spans.quote: The selected LSTM has three layers, one hundred nodes and dropout 0.1.
Both models use calendar year 2018 as the test set.
The study evaluates MAE, MSE and RMSE.

extraction_metadata.preprocessing_protocol: 60-day supervised sequences; exact scaler behavior not independently verified
